reuse.why: Ignores the existing shared getScheduledAmount and edits only the inline copy inside computeSchedulePreviewTransactions.

duplication.why: Keeps the inline missing/number/range dispatch that duplicates getScheduledAmount and writes the new endpoint rule inline instead of in the helper.

placement.why: The rule belongs in getScheduledAmount in shared/schedules.ts; it is placed in one consumer instead.

scope.why: Small and focused on the preview path, but that focus is what leaves the rest of the rule unchanged.

maintainability.why: Preview now disagrees with posting (app.ts), action sync, forecast, budget templates and the client Balance/SchedulesTable, which all still use the midpoint.

bypasses_abstraction.where: computeSchedulePreviewTransactions in packages/loot-core/src/shared/schedules.ts computes the range amount inline instead of calling getScheduledAmount in the same file

one_place.where: Only the preview inline copy in shared/schedules.ts changes; getScheduledAmount, schedules/app.ts (updateActions, postTransactionForSchedule), forecast-schedules.ts and budget/schedule-template.ts keep the midpoint
